what: The media Parallelogram tracks — the stated list. Each source is scanned every time it publishes: objects pass first (what is on the tape?), then scoring for every object with a live window, then sorting into the data sets (arcs · Readings · slate · tracker · register). Shows are readers, never the detector. A corner is an interval: three or more voices per quadrant so the station's spread (σ) can be seen.
ruled: Sailor 2026-10-15: run everything as often as it is published; several sources per graphmap quadrant, not one. Station assignments marked 'ruled' are his; 'proposed' await him.
